summary.note: Create, read and delete of sessions and configurations work with the right paths and codes, contextIds are assigned and stamped, but PUT does not store the replacement, PATCH answers 501, minItems and (External App Id, Event ID) uniqueness are not checked, and no defaults are supplied for omitted rules.

Sessions are created, read and deleted with rules merged from matching configurations and tagged with their contextIds, but session content is fixed at creation and an omitted sampling rule turns into an empty array that means "disabled".

Reports are accepted only on existing sessions and communication records are stored. A report with another Content-Type is not answered with 415, the exactly-one-record-array rule is not enforced, other record types are dropped, and "expedite": false is treated as true.

The library carries the rule types through to sessions; all client-side sampling and reporting behaviour is absent because there is no collecting client, and omitted sampling rules are not mapped to defaults.

Time-window aggregation with access-profile matching exists, but the spec names MAXIMUM and MINIMUM are rejected (code uses MIN and MAX), COUNT is not offered by the AF, an empty consumer-type list excludes everyone, and parameter, user and location restrictions are not applied.

Subscribe, read, replace, delete, immediate report and periodic or on-report notifications exist, but PUT does not re-target notifications, expiry and report-count limits are not enforced correctly, sampling ratio, group guard time and muting are absent, and only UE_COMM is produced.
There is no TLS, no authentication or OAuth 2.0, and no CORS. The API version check and the JSON content types are present.
One AF profile with three services and a feature bitmask is registered with the NRF at start-up; per-provisioning profiles, Event ID lists, CAPIF and ownership rules are absent.
No UE-side Direct Data Collection Client or R7 API exists in this repository or its branches.

summary.cluster: Data Collection AF in the 5GMS AF
summary.note: The 5GMS AF on development has no Data Collection AF and no Event Data Processing provisioning. The unmerged branch links the DCAF library but crashes on start-up because it registers no report handlers. The Application Provider has only commented-out stubs for the M1 Event Data Processing API.

The Media Session Handler and Media Stream Handler send QoE metrics and consumption reports over M5, and the AF writes them to files. Nothing feeds a Data Collection AF: the AS has no R4 client, and the AF logs neither dynamic policy nor Network Assistance invocations.
No 5GMS event is generated or exposed. The branch advertises only the UE Communication event feature and sets no event generation callback, and the Application Provider has no Event Consumer AF.
